newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 29.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 29.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones shed 4.61 points to 6,656.08. PLDT's ADR gained $1 3/4 to $58 1/2.
*The peso closed weaker at 26.340 to a U.S. dollar from 26.337.
*The Philippine Stock Exchange composite index jumped 18.89 points to 3,341.99.
*The Philippine interbank call loan average was steady at 10.53125 percent.
*PDCP Development Bank said its unaudited net income reached 118.4 million pesos in 1996.

*Far East Bank and Trust Co declared a 20 percent stock dividend. *The Securities and Exchange Commission has ordered the Philippine Stock Exchange to investigate the sharp price increases of penny stocks in recent weeks, SEC chairman Perfecto Yasay said on Tuesday.
*Philippine sugar refiner Central Azucarera Don Pedro declared on Tuesday a 30 percent stock dividend to all shareholders on record February 20.

*Moody's Investor Service placed under review for possible upgrade the long-term foreign currency debt and deposit ratings of eleven Philippine banks.The eleven banks for review for possible upgrade are Allied Banking Corp, Bank of the Philippine Islands, Development Bank of the Philippines, Equitable Banking Corp, Far East Bank and Trust Co, Land Bank of the Philippines, Metropolitan Bank and Trust Co, PCIBank, Philippine National Bank,Rizal Commercial Banking Corp and United Coconut Planters Bank.
